items.title: Public Meeting 716 Gordon Street Proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments File OZS23-003 - 2023-274, 2023-274
notes:
Katie Nasswetter, Senior Development Planner, summarized the proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment and provided details on the site context, proposed Official Plan amendment, zoning, proposed zoning, requested specialized zoning regulations, proposed site plan and proposed building rendering.

The following delegates spoke on the item:
Chris Pidgeon and Marc Villemaire provided an overview of the purposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law amendments.
Bill Mungall expressed concerns regarding noise.
Kate McDonald expressed concerns regarding building setback, parking and tree preservation. 
Tim Law expressed concerns regarding density, traffic, tree preservation and noise.
